description: Frozen train/val split membership for datasets/synthetic.jsonl. Every example is keyed by sha256 of its exact 'input' text. Anything listed under 'val' is pinned to validation; every other example -- including any new ones appended to synthetic.jsonl in future Gold releases -- defaults to train automatically. This replaces the previous random.Random(42).shuffle()-over-the-whole-file split in prepare_data.py, which silently reassigned 9 of 66 examples between train and val the moment gold_v1.2.3's 6 new examples were appended (see training/gold_v1.2.3_split_delta_report.md). Val membership now only ever changes by an explicit, reviewed edit to this file.
frozen_at: gold_v1.2.2 (66-example corpus). Reproduced directly from the original random.Random(42).shuffle(range(66))[:6] split and verified byte-identical against training/data/processed_gold_v1.2.3_fixedsplit/val.jsonl before being frozen here.
